---
name: Bug report
about: Report a reproducible problem with Shenron
---

For security vulnerabilities, use [private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/nishikawaakira/Shenron/security/advisories/new).

## Version

Paste the output of `shenron --version`.

## OS

Include the OS version and CPU architecture.

## Command

Include the command and relevant flags. Replace private paths and values.

## Expected behavior

What did you expect Shenron to do?

## Actual behavior

What did Shenron do? Include the exit code and relevant output if available.

Use synthetic or redacted logs. Remove real IP addresses, hostnames, credentials, and other private values before posting.
